question: R7/R8 的地点名 0.60：是描述短语在整句表示里丢了（表示层），还是短语还在但接不上名字（映射层）？
header_note: R3 使用外部冻结句向量，只作上界；它的读数不进能力账，也不升级/降级任何既有判定。

definition.fixture: frozen.build_fixture() describe rows only: 20 goals = 4 objects x 5 places, each written once as describe_goal = '让{object phrase}到{place phrase}。'.  No paraphrase row is used.
definition.phrases: the 9 description phrases from OBJECT_DESCRIPTIONS (4) and PLACE_DESCRIPTIONS (5).  They are the only candidates; names (蓝色杯子 / 木桌 / ...) do not appear in this round at all.
definition.reading: for each describe sentence, cosine similarity against the 4 object phrases and against the 5 place phrases; a slot is correct iff the sentence's own phrase is the arg-max.  20 samples per slot, so chance is 0.25 (object) and 0.20 (place).
definition.detail: besides accuracy the report keeps, per sample, the own-phrase cosine, the best other phrase, the margin own - best-other, and the 1-based rank of the own phrase.
definition.control: R1 is an additive byte histogram and the phrase occurs verbatim inside the sentence, so R1 localisation is the metric's positive control: it must be >= 0.95 on both slots.

arms.R2: mean of reference.encoder.context(raw) over positions (128 dims), L2-normalised; weights are the random initialisation at seed 20261031, i.e. untrained.
arms.R3: instruments.document_embedding.DocumentEmbedder on the frozen sentence-transformer; upper bound only, reported unavailable if the local cache is missing.

criteria.control: control_ok iff R1 object localisation >= 0.95 and R1 place localisation >= 0.95.  If it fails the round is control_failed and no other reading is interpreted.
criteria.localised: a slot is localised iff accuracy >= 0.80, not_localised iff accuracy <= 0.60, otherwise inconclusive.  Thresholds are fixed here, before the first reading.
criteria.attribution: read on R3 place only: phrase_survives_name_link_absent iff >= 0.80; phrase_diluted_or_absent iff <= 0.60; otherwise inconclusive.
criteria.project_side: R1/R2 localisation is reported separately: project_phrase_localised iff either arm is localised on both slots, project_phrase_not_localised iff neither arm is.  R3 cannot change this line.
criteria.r3_unavailable: if the R3 weights are not cached the verdict is r3_unavailable and no attribution is made.
criteria.no_fit: 0 training, 0 optimizer steps, 0 Adam, 0 confirm, 0 new parameters.
